passages.text:
Re: Follow up Qs
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld Monday, August 1, 2022 at 12:11:26 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Cc: [contact omitted] Adam Siegel, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
all sounds good, ty
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 12:01 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks so much, Josh.
On Moldova-we need to have a little more internal follow up and get some Qs answered.
Glad you are engraving with LAC.
I will be in touch with Thailand. i have not received feedback back from them, but will follow up.
thanks, vera
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 8:55 AM Josh Blumenfeld { [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera, Johnny, and Adam,
Thanks for following up and responses below in red.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 6:41 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey there - Ok.
I have some follow ups for you:
• our regional thailand mission is very interested in the creative cohort idea. More to follow shortly. sounds
good, some of YT's biggest markets are in SE Asia, and there may be prime overlap with your work
supporting independent media in the region, and helping them, among other things, get set up on YT so
they can reach wide audiences without censorship.
• I will put you in touch with some folks from Moldova. There maybe some interest, but a few specific
questions for you. Sounds good; the Administator raised Moldova in her meeting with Susan. Happy to
follow up.
• Our LAC communications folks at the missions would love to do a training with you guys, so that will be a
separate connect. Fantastic, we've corresponded with them about setting up the "How YouTube Works"
training that we do for civic partners across the US and the world to help them better utilize their YT
channels.
• Finally, copying Adam Siegel, Special Advisor to Administrator Power who might be able to tell us about
other countries. Adam, great to meet you. Let me know if you'd like to connect. I'm fairly flexible over the
next two weeks.
Cheers, Vera
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 2:21 PM Josh Blumenfeld [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 5:13 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
I'm checking with APAC and a few other people.
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 1:55 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds good. One element to consider is that, in apac, the markets are far more developed and youtube is
far more ubiquitous. So, all other things being equal, an independent media outlet will have a net/ net better
chance of success in a place like Indonesia than Guatemala or Honduras, for example.
Brazil and Mexico are also bigger markets generally, too, if thinking about LAC.
Not to say we can't explore Central America, just a little extra texture for consideration.

Once you have some initial feedback, I think it would be good to get our teams on the phone so we can talk
through some of the nuances.
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 12:57 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
By end of next week on cohorts. I put feelers out
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 12:55 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
any sense of when you all may have some initial feedback?
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 9:10 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Totally understand. We'd love to get the ball rolling and happy to start small
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 10:52 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
i'm gonna pass this to LAC - but this is a tight timeline. It all has to be coordinated with the
missions, and the regional bureau would need to ID the missions. So just so you know - you may
need to adjust. I'll be in touch once i hear the reception on my end.
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 5:49 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
No prob, sounds good on lac.
On trainings, we offer a standard "how you tube works" 30 to 45 min lesson that we offer for civic
partners in the US and around the world. We recently did one for all US Senate Press
Secretaries. It could be live, in dc, regional, virtual etc.
Sounds good re separate copy
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 5:39 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
This week is terrible. Let me see the response from lac on your new approach.
They also want more detail from youon what trainings for communicators in missions might
look like.
They are supposed to come back to me with countries of interest. I'll share with you separately
the other request
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 5:37 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Of course. Pilot in LAC sounds great. Sure let me know if you want to set up a phone call
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 5:34 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi!
Let me share this refined approach. We're thinking a pilot with LAC first. I'll get back to
you. Ok? Also, I have specific asks for you
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 12:11 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera,
Any updates on your end?
We've refined the thinking further, and eager to kick this off. Should we schedule a time
for our teams to discussfurther?
Many thanks,
Josh
On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 12:07 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 11:28 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
wrote:
Y, google team is on it.
on the media doc, feel free to just edit directly into the concept with whatever you
all think is most appropriate/ actionable and we can go from there.

On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 8:14 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Ps. Try to ping Ria on those Qs
On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 7:56 AM Josh Blumenfeld [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
wrote:
Hi, no reason in particular, more illustrative than anything else. We are open
to any region/ countries.
On Mon, Jul 11, 2022 at 3:04 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Josh,
Just to follow up. We have to do some internal exploration as to the number
of regions / cohorts/ timelines. Out of curiosity - is there a reason you are
pushing for Asia or Sub-Saharan Africa? Is there some flexibility for
us. There maybe some interest in doing something in LAC, but I have to
investigate.
Thanks so much, Vera
On Fri, Jul 8, 2022 at 8:45 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi there,
Here are follow up Qs.
Cheers, Vera
Vera Zakem
Senior Technology and Policy Advisor
USAID
